title: 4521-CAL-AGE-75-52-0001 Rev1
summary:
- The document describes the design of TES exchanger foundations for Solana Generating Station.
- Foundation dimensions and materials are specified, including concrete and steel grades.
- Ground bearing capacity is analyzed using test borings.
- Safety factors and load combinations are defined according to specific codes.
- Results from CYPECAD and SAP2000 software are presented in annexes.
